subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Radio Waves: Communication Begins
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Radio Waves: Communication Begins.

hook.text: Hertz proved electromagnetic waves exist in 1887 — sparks leapt across a gap in his receiver.

buildup.text: Marconi sent radio signals across the Atlantic in 1901. Wireless was born.

discovery.text: Radio waves bend around hills, bounce off the ionosphere, and pass through walls.

twist.text: AM carries audio by varying wave height. FM varies frequency — clearer but shorter range.

climax.text: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and cell signals are all radio waves at different frequencies.

punchline.text: Hertz made sparks. Marconi crossed oceans. Radio changed everything.

quiz.question: How did Hertz prove electromagnetic waves exist?
options: He measured the speed of light with a rotating mirror
He generated sparks that induced detectable signals in a remote receiver
He observed radio waves bending around the Earth's surface
